title: Use TDD at an approved behavior seam without imposing it on docs

rubric.text: Directs the behavior owner to use tdd at the user-approved public seam and does not invoke the separate implement skill
Uses focused documentation validation and owner self-review for the documentation-only item without inventing a TDD seam
Allows both ready independent items to run concurrently in isolated worktrees, subject to capability and capacity
Reviews the supplied state without starting agents or mutating the repository
